rca_of_the_issue: Session binding is working correctly. The X-Session-Device header fallback in deps.py (line 62) correctly reads the header when cookie is not present. Frontend api.js (line 99) correctly sends X-Session-Device header. The issue seen in browser testing is likely due to cross-origin cookie restrictions (SameSite=lax) where the device_id cookie set by backend is not being sent by browser in subsequent requests. This is a browser security feature, not a code bug.
